headline: Overall guidance delivery was largely in line with expectations for Whole Bank and Retail segments, though some claims were moving or ambiguous.

segments.Whole Bank: Net Interest Margin moved as expected, while Cost-to-Income Ratio and Advance Growth remained ambiguous. Credit Quality indicators such as Net NPA % and Credit Cost showed improvement, aligning with guidance.
segments.Retail: Retail Share of Advances improved, moving in line with expectations.

keyThemes: Stable credit growth and improving asset quality
Focus on deposit growth to maintain LDR below 90%
Positive outlook for loan growth driven by favorable macroeconomic conditions
Continued investment in technology and distribution
